revision_safety: derived from the fitted packet site/tendon order + the fit's own recorded transforms and measurements; nothing re-measured or re-invented.
port_vs_waypoint_rule: a site is a FIRST/LAST ENDPOINT of tendon X only when it is the first/last entry of X's ordered site_names; intermediate entries are waypoints and never endpoints for that tendon. Endpoint roles are NOT mechanical qualifications: every site ships mechanical_qualification=false.
